messages:
Alex: proposing a new composite regional-availability SLI to cut down noisy global error-budget burn from short region flaps. idea: weight per-region success by stable traffic share + partial credit for quick failovers. PTAL.

Mina: can you sketch the math? do we weight by avg traffic or p95? and how to treat cross-region failovers?

Alex: sketch below. per-region availability (5m):
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total{region=~".+",status=~"2.."}[5m])) by (region)
/ sum(rate(http_requests_total{region=~".+"}[5m])) by (region)
```
traffic share use a 7d rolling avg:
```
sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m])) by (region) / sum(rate(http_requests_total[5m]))
# but compute avg over 7d for stable share
```
global_avail = sum(region_avail * region_traffic_share)  (rolling 1h for region_avail)

Also: if failover completes within 30s, apply credit_factor=0.5 to downtime seconds (so short failovers don't count as full outage).

Ryan: burn math: convert incidents into equivalent downtime seconds = outage_seconds * credit_factor (0.5 if <30s). error_budget_burn = downtime_seconds / (slo_window_seconds * (1 - SLO)). Makes alerts easier to threshold.

Jess: current problem is single-region 5m blips cause global burn alerts. counterproposal: (1) per-region alerts with higher thresholds and longer windows, (2) global-equivalent-burn alert that fires only on aggregated equivalent downtime.

sre-oncall: last week we had 18 regional blips <20s that caused 6 global pages. paging noise is real :grimacing:.

Alex: draft alert rules:
- regional-availability-warning: per-region availability < 99.5% over 5m -> create ticket (no page)
- regional-availability-critical: per-region availability < 99% over 15m -> page oncall
- global-equivalent-burn: if equivalent_downtime_seconds(1h) > 300 -> page

Jess: add saturation labeling too. GPU pool saturation often raises latency without 5xxs; we should tag causes: cause={sat,gpu,network,app} so burn splits by root cause.

Alex: agreed. incidents should carry cause label.

Mina: recommend adding synthetic probes per-region and for dedicated GPU pools. probe frequency 30s, failure window 3m. probes hit representative endpoints (health + a light model ping).

Ryan: probe config example:
```
- name: region-eu-probe
  region: eu-west
  url: https://eu-west.redwood-inference/api/health
  interval: 30s
  failure_window: 3m
```

Jess: runbook changes: annotate incidents with "partial-credit" if failover <30s. add play for saturation-led latency: check queue depth, scale GPU pool, evict noncritical jobs, and verify KV cache pressure.

Alex: action items:
- Alex -> update Grafana SLO panels and error-budget calc (infra-observability repo)
- Ryan -> add probe configs and deploy to probe fleet
- Jess -> update runbooks + alert playbooks
- Mina -> validate logic against last 30 days of metrics

Ryan: will open PR with probe configs and a simulation vs recent incidents.

ci-bot: PR #452 opened: "observability: composite regional SLI + probe configs" by Ryan.

Mina: thought: traffic_share should be based on expected traffic (7d avg) rather than instantaneous share. if a region is already down, instantaneous share will be 0 and can skew short-term numbers if one big customer shifts. 7d avg smooths that.

Alex: good call. region_traffic_share = 7d rolling avg; region_avail = 1h rolling. keeps stability but still responsive.

Jess: can we stage this behind a 7-day canary in staging? run it for a week then flip prod if metrics look sane.

Alex: plan: merge to staging, run 7-day canary, then switch prod and monitor global-equivalent-burn for 48h. tag @sre-oncall to watch.

sre-oncall: ack :thumbsup:.

ci-bot: PR #452 merged to staging (infra-observability:v2.14).

Ryan: demoed simulated probe results in PR. simulated 20s failover: equivalent downtime used 50% credit and global_burn reflected reduced impact.

Mina: posted validation charts: https://grafana.internal/d/xxxx/regional-sli-validation (chart attached).

Jess: scheduling 7-day canary starting tomorrow 03:00 UTC. will add calendar entry and update runbook.

Alex: I'll update the error-budget export so Finance/Product dashboards show the new composite SLI and add a changelog note.

Jess: please also prepare a short customer-facing blurb: "SLO calc updated: composite regional weighting" so historical burn numbers have context. tagging Marketing.

Marketing: received, will draft small note for customers and portal.

sre-oncall: will watch global-equivalent-burn during rollout and escalate if pages spike.

Alex: closing loop next week with rollout status and lessons learned. thanks everyone.
